title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that the answer is (a).

title: Understanding of Wave Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of how unpolarized electrons can be represented by a wave function.

title: Knowledge of Polarization
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the concept of polarization in relation to electron spin states.

title: Clarification of Options
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide reasoning for why options (b) and (c) are incorrect.

title: Common Misconception
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid stating that unpolarized electrons cannot be described by a wave function.
